I have farmed these 2 mu in Quzhou for 37 years. I am 56 and I finished middle school. I go to the input shop in town sometimes, but mostly I watch what my neighbors do and copy the ones who get good yields.

This year I will grow chili on both mu, same as last year. I will hire the rotary tiller in April — 50 yuan per mu, 100 yuan total. I will buy hybrid chili seedlings, 3,500 plants per mu. That is 7,000 seedlings for my whole farm, costing about 200 yuan per mu. Last year I only used 3,000 plants per mu and got about 3,000 jin per mu. My neighbor Lao Wang planted 3,500 per mu and his yield was higher, so this year I will do what he did. It costs more, but bad seedling density is worse than spending a little extra.

For fertilizer, I will put down 80 kg per mu of compound fertilizer before transplanting — the 15-15-15 kind, two 40-kg bags per mu. That is 320 yuan for compound. When the plants flower in June, I will topdress with 25 kg per mu of urea and 15 kg per mu of potassium sulfate. I know that is a lot for 2 mu, but last year I put less urea and the leaves turned yellow. I would rather waste 50 yuan on extra fertilizer than lose 1,000 yuan on yield. A bad harvest is a disaster; wasting some fertilizer is just a cost.

I have a well, so I will irrigate 5 times: once right after transplanting in late April, then every 10 to 15 days when the hot weather comes. Each time I flood the border and it takes me half a day. For pesticides, I will spray 8 times total. Five times for aphids and caterpillars, three times for disease. I buy the bottles from the agro shop in town. Each spray costs me about 15 yuan per mu for the chemical, plus my own labor. I do not skip sprays because one week of insects can ruin two months of work.

I expect about 3,200 kg per mu this year if the weather is normal. That is 6,400 kg from my 2 mu. Last year I sold at about 2 yuan per kg. If I get that price again, I can pay for my inputs and still have money left for the household. My wife works in the garment factory in town, so I do most of the field work myself, but she helps during harvest.
